summary: The original spell-combination action game and its modern stability route.

entries.title: Magicka

emulation.notes: Native Windows game; legacy .NET, DirectX 9, and XNA components may be required.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC output with the community stability patch.

primary.version: Steam Complete Edition with Magicka Community Patch
primary.why: Magicka shipped for Windows, and the current Steam Complete Edition is the straightforward content-complete purchase. A late official update introduced frequent crashes and other bugs; the community patch is specifically intended to preserve the original gameplay while fixing long-session crashes, memory leaks, and scene-transition instability.
primary.how_to_play: Install the Steam Complete Edition, then the current Magicka Community Patch. Keep the original aspect ratio or use the game's supported widescreen modes, and retain a clean save backup before adding the patch.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows release with widescreen and ultrawide support; Complete Edition bundles the available content.
all_releases.reason: primary: the only native release family, stabilized on modern Windows with the community patch.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No platform split exists; the real conflict is official-build instability versus using a preservation-focused community patch.

entries.remaster_caveats: There is no remaster. The final official build is known for crashes and regressions, so the community stability patch is part of the recommended modern route rather than an optional enhancement.
